neighbours.label: verbs of achieving or reaching (achieved, accomplish, reaches, ranks)
fire: The first two locks on the canal achieved a rise of fifty feet.
These cheap insoles accomplish the job of cushioning the heel.
The new engine achieves a top speed of 200 miles per hour.
Our small team accomplished every goal we set in March.
The old tower reaches almost to the clouds on misty days.
This temple ranks among the finest buildings in the province.
With practice the choir achieved a remarkable harmony.
The ladder reaches all the way to the roof of the barn.
quiet: The first two locks on the canal were built in the spring.
These cheap insoles are made of thin foam and rubber.
The new engine is painted red and sits under the hood.
Our small team met every Monday in March.
The old tower stands near the river on misty days.
This temple sits among the oldest buildings in the province.
With practice the choir sang every Sunday.
The ladder leans against the wall of the barn.

notes: achieved x2, achieves x2, accomplish, ranks, Arabic yasil (reaches).
